verdicts.reason: Both crops lose the dropper bottles; only a green sliver is left clipped at the right edge. Both also cut the beige brush-stroke away from the title, so it floats as an empty blob that looks like a mistake. A keeps 'Spa Utopia' and its subline on clean background below the glass bowl, but the title block is small and leaves a dead lower third. In B the oversized title runs into the bottom of the glass bowl, putting text on the image, and the left margin is cramped.
